blocks.html:
This method deletes a search index, dropping every physical index ever built
for it along with the versions and sync history behind them. The next
migration rebuilds it from scratch, starting at version 1. Until it runs,
nothing serves reads for this index.

types.name: id
types.description: The name of the index to delete.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: deleted_versions

How many of the index's versions were dropped. `0` when the index is
registered but was never migrated.
